edits.modify_from: (4) write that container's last-frame position. Never match the carried value straight to the last frame.
edits.modify_to: (4) write that container's last-frame position. Never match the carried value straight to the last frame. Mandatory joint procedure: (a) if any frame shows a container displaced from its position in the previous frame by more than a few pixels, run the chain for ALL THREE colors through every frame as a ONE-TO-ONE ASSIGNMENT: in each frame each container is assigned to exactly one color, so two fields can never end on the same container, and a container that one color leaves must be taken up by another color; (b) when the nearest candidate for one color is a near-tie (displacements within a few pixels of each other), choose the assignment that also gives the other colors a distinct nearest container with the smallest total displacement; (c) an identical container layout in the first and last frames of a step does not mean nothing moved; if middle frames show displacement, the result is usually a swap of two colors, and the chain decides which; (d) consistency check before writing: the three written values must be three different containers of the last frame, and if one field moved to a new container, the field that carried that container's old position must have moved too.
